transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

My mom brought me. Mostly, I just... I can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room all day. I stay in the same clothes. I used to do things—like knit, or write in my journal, or go for walks—but I just don't anymore. And when my mom asks me what's wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Over the past couple of weeks, how has your mood been? Do you feel sad, empty, or down most of the day?

I don't think I feel sad. Um... I'm not crying or feeling down, really. I just don't feel much of anything. It's not like a sad feeling, I mean... I'm just kind of there. I just don't have the energy to care about stuff, but I wouldn't say I'm sad.
When did you first notice that you started feeling this way—like you didn't have energy and lost interest in the things you used to do? Can you think of roughly when this started?
It's been a while. Um... this whole decline has been going on since I started a community-college program. That was about two years and two months ago, I think. That's really when it all started.

You mentioned this started about two years ago when you began college. Has this low energy and lack of interest been going on continuously for this entire two-year period, or have there been times when you felt better or more like yourself?

Um... I'm not really sure. I don't think there were times when I felt better. It just... it feels like it's been like this the whole time. I can't really remember feeling like myself since it started.

Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, or where your mood was very high or expansive—maybe where you felt like you could do anything, or needed less sleep than usual? If so, how long did those periods last?

No, I haven't. Um... I don't think I've ever felt like that. I definitely don't get bursts of energy or feel like I can do anything. It's usually the opposite, really. And I always need my sleep, I've never gone without it. So, no, I haven't had any periods like what you're describing.

Over these past two years, have there been any weeks or months where your energy or motivation improved noticeably, even if just a little bit, or has the low energy stayed pretty much the same the whole time?
Um, no, not really. I haven't noticed any weeks or months where it got better. It's... it's just stayed pretty much exactly the same the whole time. Just that same low energy without any breaks.
Before this two-year period started, in the years before you began college, would you say your mood and energy were normal? Did you feel like yourself back then?

Um... yeah, I think so. Before college started, back in high school, I was just... normal, I guess. I had regular energy and I felt like myself. I don't remember having any problems with my mood or anything before these last two years. It really just started changing when I went to college.

During these two years, have there been any times—even just a few days or a week—where you felt a little bit better, had slightly more energy, or felt a bit more interested in things, before it went back to how it usually is?

Um... no, not really. I don't remember any days or weeks where I felt better or had more energy. It's just... it's been pretty constant this whole time. I haven't really had any breaks where I felt more interested in things, it just stays the same.

During these two years, have you noticed any pattern to how you feel—like certain times of day, certain days of the week, or certain situations where your energy or motivation might be even slightly different, or does it feel completely the same all the time?

No, there's no pattern to it. It just feels completely the same all the time. Mostly I just... I can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room with the same clothes on. I don't do the things I used to do, like... I don't knit or journal or go walking. It doesn't matter what time of day it is. And when my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to answer her.

During these two years, have you experienced periods of worry, anxiety, or feeling tense in your body—like muscle tension or nervousness—or has it mainly just been the low energy and lack of interest?

Um... no, not really. I don't feel worried or... or nervous about things. My body doesn't get tense or anything like that. It really has just been the low energy and... not having any interest in stuff. I don't really feel anxious, I just don't feel like doing anything.
Before you started college two years ago, did you ever have a period—maybe lasting weeks or months—where you felt depressed, had very low energy, or lost interest in things you normally enjoyed?

No, I don't think so. Before college... things were fine. I used to do my knitting and journaling and hanging out with friends. I didn't feel like this back then. It really just started a couple years ago.

I want to make sure I have this right—when you were in high school and before college, did you ever go through any period, even a short one, where you felt down or depressed, lost interest in things, or had very low energy for at least a couple of weeks?

No, I never felt like this back then. Like I said, I was fine in high school. I had energy and did things. I never had any time where I felt depressed or stopped doing things for weeks. It really just started when I went to college.
